scenes.headline: THE POKÉMON THAT STARTS THEM ALL
scenes.narration: Meet Bulbasaur. The Pokémon that starts the entire Pokédex.
scenes.caption: Meet Bulbasaur — the Pokémon that starts the entire Pokédex.

scenes.headline: BEFORE LEGENDS, THERE WAS #001
scenes.narration: Before legends and dragons, there was number zero zero one.
scenes.caption: Before legends and dragons, there was number #001.

scenes.headline: TWO TYPES. NO EVOLUTION NEEDED.
scenes.narration: Grass and Poison from day one, giving it an early game advantage.
scenes.caption: GRASS and POISON from day one.

scenes.headline: THE SEED IS PART OF ITS STORY
scenes.narration: The seed on its back grows with it, storing energy from sunlight.
scenes.caption: Its seed grows with it — powered by sunlight.

scenes.headline: SEED TO FULL BLOOM
scenes.narration: At sixteen, Ivysaur. At thirty two, Venusaur. Seed to full bloom.
scenes.caption: LEVEL 16 → IVYSAUR   •   LEVEL 32 → VENUSAUR

scenes.headline: SMALL STARTER. SERIOUS TOOLKIT.
scenes.narration: Vines, spores, healing, and Solar Beam. Small starter, serious control.
scenes.caption: VINE WHIP • SLEEP POWDER • LEECH SEED • SOLAR BEAM
